references.title: Experimental evidence on the productivity effects of generative artificial intelligence
references.claim_check_scope: Verified 2026-10-27 against PubMed bibliographic record and abstract. Preregistered experiment on professional writing with ChatGPT assistance supports shorter completion time and improved output quality. It does not establish autonomous labor replacement or similarity of decision preferences.

references.title: Generative AI at work
references.claim_check_scope: Verified 2026-10-27 against final publisher record, abstract, and introduction. AI assistance improved productivity among 5,172 customer-support agents; the final article reports 15%, not the earlier working-paper figures. Manuscript cites only the qualitative efficiency finding. Human agents retained responsibility; this is not evidence of independent model decisions or preference equivalence.

references.title: A Turing test of whether AI chatbots are behaviorally similar to humans
references.claim_check_scope: Verified 2026-10-27 against primary PNAS metadata, methods, and results. Examines GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4 with personality measures and behavioral games. Supports task-specific behavioral comparison, with similarities alongside more concentrated or cooperative choices. Its distribution-based discrimination test differs from the present descriptive scores and does not validate this tool. DOI 10.1073/pnas.2401336121 is a commentary by Juanjuan Meng, not a correction.
